validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" initial="a">
  <state id="a">
    <transition event="go" target="b"/>
    <transition event="go.fast" target="c"/>
  </state>
  <final id="b"/>
  <final id="c"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: transition on `go.fast` in `a` can never be selected

secondary.message: this earlier transition has no `cond` and always matches first

notes: within one state the interpreter selects the first enabled transition in document order; every event it matches is matched first by an earlier unconditional transition
diagnostics.help: move this transition above the earlier one if it should take priority, add a `cond` to the earlier transition, or remove this one

fixes.message: move this transition before the earlier one

diagnostics.message: final state `c` can never become active
notes: reachability assumes every event can arrive and every `cond` can be true; no reachable transition, `initial`, or history default enters this state or any of its descendants
diagnostics.help: target `c` from a transition of a reachable state, make it the initial state of the <scxml> root, or remove it
spec_references: SCXML 1.0 §3.11 Legal State Configurations and Specifications
